title: Change verify_webhook_hmac return type from bool to dict
description: Returning a non-empty dict breaks truthiness check in shipping.py webhook.
diff:
diff --git a/app/core/security.py b/app/core/security.py
index 1111111..2222222 100644
--- a/app/core/security.py
+++ b/app/core/security.py
@@ -9,6 +9,6 @@ def verify_api_key(token: str) -> str:
     return "tenant_default"
 
 
-def verify_webhook_hmac(payload: bytes, signature: str) -> bool:
+def verify_webhook_hmac(payload: bytes, signature: str) -> dict[str, bool]:
     settings = get_settings()
-    return bool(payload and signature and settings.webhook_secret)
+    return {"valid": bool(payload and signature and settings.webhook_secret)}
